description.fun: Woobat sleeps stuck to cave walls by the suction of its nostrils, leaving a heart-shaped mark behind, so a wall lined with hearts means Woobat live in that cave. A heart-shaped mark left on someone is said to bring good fortune. It finds its way, and its Bug-type prey, with ultrasonic waves from its nose. It looks like a Honduran white bat, the fluffy kind that roosts curled up together under leaves.
description.guide: Woobat is a Psychic- and Flying-type bat Pokémon with a heart-shaped nose. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense its surroundings and sticks to cave walls with its nostrils when it sleeps, leaving heart-shaped marks. It evolves into Swoobat with high friendship.
description.tagline: A fluffy bat that leaves heart-shaped marks on cave walls.

description.fun: Swoobat's heart-shaped nose looks so auspicious that some regions consider it a symbol of good luck. It emits sound waves of all kinds from it: shaking its tail, it can reduce concrete to rubble, while a courting male's waves lift the mood of anyone who hears them. All that effort wears it out, though, and it can't fly for a while afterward.
description.guide: Swoobat is the evolved form of Woobat, a Psychic- and Flying-type bat with a heart-shaped nose. It emits ultrasonic waves of many frequencies, some strong enough to break concrete. Its nose is considered a symbol of good luck in some regions.
description.tagline: A lucky heart-nosed bat whose love songs lift your mood.
